title: 第11章 你认真的样子很帅
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陆小小站在车门边，望着外面那片遮天蔽日的原始森林。

“地铁站台外面是原始森林，这合理吗？”

凌云靠在车门另一侧，语气平淡地回了一句：“大家都已经参加地铁生存游戏了，还有什么合理不合理的。”

陆小小张了张嘴，发现自己无法反驳。

“我们要下车吗？”顾佳佳小声地问道，似乎担心声音太高，惊扰到原始森林中潜藏的可怕存在。

没人回答。

就在这时，一道极淡的金色光晕从秦守身上掠过。

他低头一看——身上凭空多了一套衣服。白色T恤，深蓝牛仔裤。

几乎同时，自动售货机里也亮起了一团金光，金光散去之后，货架上昨天被拿空的矿泉水、可乐、泡面、小面包重新排列得整整齐齐，瓶身上还挂着冷凝的水珠。

“零点。”秦守对自己重新穿上衣服非常满意，又看了看售货机里满满当当的物资，“初始者天赋刷新了。”

“秦守，你终于穿衣服了！”陆小小嘻嘻笑道，“你穿衣服的样子还挺帅，不过——没穿的时候更帅。”

秦守把T恤下摆往下扯了扯。

哎，不对啊，他一个大老爷们，怎么感觉被小黄丫头调戏了？

“好了。”姜瑶从售货机旁边站起来，目光在秦守的新衣服上停了一瞬，然后迅速移开，“说正事，我们究竟要不要下车？”

“我觉得没必要。”叶知秋分析道，“我们现在不缺物资。秦守的初始者天赋每天刷新一整套售货机物资，水、食物都不用愁。外面的原始森林看着就让人后脊发凉，没必要冒险。”

顾佳佳道：“我赞同知秋姐的看法！”

陆小小、方小雅也都表示赞同，没必要去冒险。

姜瑶认真思考了一阵，说道：“现在情况不明，我们的确没必要冒险。反正时间还长，这次站台停靠十二个小时，我们先在聊天频道看看其他队伍的情况。”

这个提议得到了所有人的一致同意。

九女加上秦守，在老式电脑屏幕前围成了一个小半圈。

不知道是不是故意的，秦守刚坐下，顾佳佳就从左边挤了过来，苏青青从右边贴了过来，旁边的叶知秋、方小雅似乎也在往这边挤。

“等等，等等，你们别挤！”秦守尽量缩了缩身子，但四面八方都是包围圈。

往后挪，后背险些撞上方小雅，她只穿着三点式比基尼，肩胛骨隔着薄薄的布料微微凸起，秦守赶紧闪开。

往左一闪，手肘擦过顾佳佳赤裸的肩头，她锁骨下方被比基尼布料勒出的柔软弧线随着动作轻轻晃了一下，脸颊泛起一层薄红。

太难了！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lu Xiaoxiao stood by the car door, looking out at the virgin forest that blocked the sky and the sun.

"There is a primeval forest outside the subway platform. Is this reasonable?"

Ling Yun leaned on the other side of the car door and replied in a calm tone: "Everyone has already participated in the subway survival game, what else is reasonable and unreasonable."

Lu Xiaoxiao opened his mouth and found that he could not refute.

"Should we get off the car?" Gu Jiajia asked in a low voice, as if she was worried that the voice would be too loud and disturb the terrifying existence lurking in the primeval forest.

No one answered.

At this moment, a very faint golden halo passed over Qin Shou.

He looked down - there was an extra set of clothes on him out of thin air.White T-shirt, dark blue jeans.

Almost at the same time, a golden light also lit up in the vending machine. After the golden light dissipated, the mineral water, cola, instant noodles, and buns that had been emptied yesterday were neatly rearranged on the shelves, with condensed water droplets still hanging on the bottles.

"Zero o'clock." Qin Shou was very satisfied with himself putting on his clothes again, and then looked at the supplies in the vending machine, "The beginner's talent has been refreshed."

"Qin Shou, you are finally wearing clothes!" Lu Xiaoxiao giggled, "You look quite handsome in clothes, but - you are even more handsome without clothes."

Qin Shou pulled down the hem of his T-shirt.

Hey, that's not right. As a grown man, how could he feel that he was being teased by a little yellow girl?

"Okay." Jiang Yao stood up from the vending machine, her eyes paused on Qin Shou's new clothes for a moment, and then quickly moved away, "Let's get down to business, should we get off the car?"

"I don't think it's necessary." Ye Zhiqiu analyzed, "We are not short of supplies now. Qin Shou's beginner talent refreshes a complete set of vending machine supplies every day, so you don't have to worry about water and food. The virgin forest outside will give you chills down your spine just looking at it. There is no need to take risks."

Gu Jiajia said: "I agree with Sister Zhiqiu!"

Lu Xiaoxiao and Fang Xiaoya also agreed that there was no need to take risks.

Jiang Yao thought carefully for a while and said: "The situation is unclear now, and we really don't need to take risks. Anyway, it will take a long time. This time the platform will be parked for twelve hours. Let's check the situation of other teams in the chat channel first."

This proposal was unanimously approved by everyone.

The nine girls and Qin Shou formed a small half circle in front of the old computer screen.

I don't know if it was intentional, but as soon as Qin Shou sat down, Gu Jiajia squeezed in from the left, Su Qingqing pressed in from the right, and Ye Zhiqiu and Fang Xiaoya next to him seemed to be pushing in this way too.

"Wait, wait, don't squeeze!" Qin Shou shrank as much as possible, but he was surrounded in all directions.

Moving back, his back almost hit Fang Xiaoya. She was only wearing a three-point bikini, and her shoulder blades were slightly bulging through the thin fabric. Qin Shou quickly got out of the way.

She flashed to the left and brushed her elbow against Gu Jiajia's bare shoulder. The soft arc drawn by the bikini fabric under her collarbone swayed slightly with the movement, and a thin layer of red appeared on her cheeks.

It’s so difficult!
